Pricing

From £25/hr · Emerging
Our emerging tutors, trained and overseen by our founder. Great-value support across all of our subjects.
From £40/hr · Academic
Experienced tutors and more intensive support for all ages and subjects, exams, and expert SEN support.
From £65/hr · Specialist
Complex SEN needs, critical exam prep, and extra hours of lesson planning and custom resources built for you.
